clue.text: Getting to everybody in the circle

indicators.note: in places the word for everybody inside the word for the circle

parts.note: a circle is a ring
everybody, one by one, is each

explanation.surface: Someone manages to get a message to every member of a group.
explanation.definitionFit: Reaching a place means arriving there, a synonym of getting to.

clue.text: Scriptwriter working under testing conditions

parts.note: the script is an exam paper, and the writer is a candidate sitting in an exam hall

explanation.surface: A screenwriter drafting under pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scriptwriter' suggests films; here a script is an exam answer paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A candidate sitting a test writes answer scripts under exam conditions.

clue.text: Jim can lay tea out for frontierswoman

indicators.note: out signals the letters of Jim can lay tea are put out of order

explanation.surface: Jim sets out tea for a pioneer woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Martha Canary, known by this nickname, was a famous scout and sharpshooter of the American Wild West.

clue.text: Tristan's lover is almost his senior

indicators.note: almost means the word for senior is cut short of its final letter

parts.note: senior means older

explanation.surface: Tristan's beloved is nearly older than he is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the last letter of OLDER; 'his' only serves the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Arthurian romance and Wagner's opera, the Irish princess loved by Tristan bears this name.

clue.text: Impudence beginning to grate on everybody

indicators.note: beginning to picks out the opening letter of the word grate

parts.note: everybody means all

explanation.surface: Someone's cheek starts to annoy everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' places G above ALL.
explanation.definitionFit: Gall is brazen cheek or effrontery.

clue.text: Strict control of press cards that are issued

parts.note: to iron clothes is to press them
a hand is the set of cards dealt to a player

explanation.surface: A card game where the dealer is pressed to keep things tight.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruling with an iron hand means firm, harsh authority.

clue.text: No more than just

explanation.surface: Merely that.
explanation.definitionFit: Only means merely or simply, and also no more than a stated amount.

clue.text: Trail one travels from East

indicators.note: travels signals the letters of trail and one moving around into a new order

explanation.surface: A traveller follows a path from the East.
explanation.definitionFit: Oriental means of or coming from the Orient, the eastern lands.

clue.text: Raise for discussion-ship or plane

parts.note: to air a topic is to bring it up for debate
a liner is a large passenger ship

explanation.surface: A debate topic offered: should travel be by sea or by air?
explanation.definitionFit: A large passenger aircraft is called an airliner, a kind of plane.

clue.text: Note two new drivers have an accident

parts.note: fa is a note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: two asks for the letter for new drivers to be written twice

parts.note: L is the learner plate shown by new drivers in Britain

explanation.surface: A report notes that two learner drivers have crashed.
explanation.walkthrough: FA is the fourth note of the sol-fa scale; L plates mark learner drivers in the UK, so new drivers give L, doubled by 'two'.
explanation.definitionFit: To fall over or tumble is an idiomatic kind of accident, a mishap.

clue.text: An old-time chorus to conclude the evening?

definitions.text: An old-time chorus to conclude the evening?

parts.words: An old-time chorus to conclude the evening
parts.note: describes the Scots song about times long past sung at the close of a party or at New Year

explanation.surface: Someone suggests a nostalgic singalong to end the night.
explanation.walkthrough: The Scots title means 'old long since', so 'old-time' is a literal gloss; it is traditionally sung at midnight on New Year's Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: Burns's song of long-ago friendship is the customary closing chorus at gatherings.

clue.text: Fun riding on little platform with rollers below

definitions.text: Fun riding on little platform with rollers below

parts.words: Fun riding on little platform with rollers below
parts.note: the rollers are waves and the little platform is a board stood on for sport, not a skate on wheels

explanation.surface: Sounds like skateboarding: riding a small deck on wheels for fun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rollers' suggests wheels; here they are breaking waves.
explanation.definitionFit: The sport of riding waves standing on a board.

clue.text: Falling in brief violent episode

explanation.surface: A short burst of violence breaks out among people falling into line.
explanation.definitionFit: Light falling on a surface is called incident in physics; separately, a short violent occurrence is an incident.

clue.text: Travelling fast-the fashion when riding

parts.note: ton, as in bon ton, is fashion or style
up means on horseback, as a jockey is up

explanation.surface: Fashion on horseback moves at speed.
explanation.walkthrough: A ton-up is British slang for doing 100 mph, typically on a motorbike.
explanation.definitionFit: Ton-up describes going at a hundred miles an hour, i.e. high speed.

clue.text: These days, disagreement is out of control

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, marks the present era
a rift is a split or quarrel

explanation.surface: Modern quarrelling has got out of hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat adrift floats unsteered, so the word means drifting without direction.

clue.text: Raise tax

explanation.surface: Put up a tax.
explanation.definitionFit: To levy money is to raise it by authority; a levy is also a duty or tax imposed.

clue.text: A guiding light, look! valuable about the way

parts.note: lo is an old word for look

indicators.note: about says the word for valuable goes around the abbreviation for the way

parts.note: dear means costly or valuable
ST, street, is a way

explanation.surface: Look how precious that beacon on the road is!
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps DEAR round ST to make DESTAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A lodestar is the pole star used by navigators, hence a guide.

clue.text: Led in for punishment, given protection inside

indicators.note: the letters of the words led in are punished, knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A prisoner is taken in for punishment but given shelter indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: A coat that is lined has a layer added inside to protect or insulate it.

clue.text: Rued being weak-tend to fall

parts.note: a lame excuse is a weak one

indicators.note: to fall suggests the letters of tend tumbling into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone regrets their frailty and tendency to stumble.
explanation.definitionFit: Lamented means mourned or regretted.

clue.text: We hear dance is a scream

indicators.note: we hear says the word for a dance is spoken, matching another spelling

parts.note: a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: Gossip has it that the dance was hilarious fun.
explanation.definitionFit: To bawl is to cry or shout loudly, a synonym of scream.

clue.text: Make giant steps, and radiate pride?

explanation.surface: Taking big strides and showing self-respect.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, it is stepping out as a giant would; idiomatically it means carrying oneself with confidence.

clue.text: Abandon weapon? Mad, sir, mad

indicators.note: the closing mad says the letters of mad and sir go wild into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone tells a crazed gentleman to put down his gun.
explanation.definitionFit: To disarm is to lay down or take away arms, giving up weapons.

clue.text: Easily moved left to fit

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
fit, as in fit to do something, means able

explanation.surface: Instructions to steer left so the cargo fits.
explanation.definitionFit: Something portable can be carried about, so it is readily transported.

clue.text: One planning course is right on part of target

parts.note: the outer is a ring of an archery or shooting target

explanation.surface: An archer's coach on target.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' places R above OUTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who routes works out the route or path, a planner.

clue.text: Found, as Danes rampage, unharmed

indicators.note: the Danes rampage, so the letters of found, as and Danes run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: A Viking raid ends with a missing person recovered unhurt.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means having come through danger with no injury, an idiom for uninjured.

clue.text: Panic, needing strong drink

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Panic, needing strong drink' for FLAP: FLAP is panic, but no reading of 'needing strong drink' gives anything; likely OCR or garbled, and no source found.

clue.text: Violently criticise big contract

explanation.surface: Attacking a major deal.
explanation.definitionFit: To slam is to attack harshly in words; in bridge a slam is a contract to win all or all but one trick.

clue.text: I'm a leader of mosque

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe dropped

indicators.note: leader of picks out the opening letter of the word mosque

explanation.surface: A prayer leader introduces himself.
explanation.definitionFit: An imam leads prayers in a mosque, so the whole clue is the speaker's own description.

clue.text: Something detestable in three articles put before scholar

parts.note: an is an indefinite article
a is the other indefinite article
the is the definite article
MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate scholar

explanation.surface: Something hateful is found in a scholar's three published papers.
explanation.walkthrough: Grammatical articles, not essays: AN, A and THE, followed by MA.
explanation.definitionFit: An anathema is a thing loathed or cursed, something abhorrent.

clue.text: Spoil one yellow flower

parts.note: to mar is to spoil or damage
I is the Roman numeral one
gold is a yellow colour

explanation.surface: A gardener warns against damaging a single yellow bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: The marigold is a common orange or yellow garden bloom, a type of plant in flower.
